headline: 80 kmph winds: Flood risk in 16 districts as water rises in 38 rivers
summary: Severe storms and heavy rain are threatening coastal areas, with water levels rising in 38 rivers across Bangladesh.
details: Severe weather warnings have been issued as 80 kmph winds and very heavy rainfall are expected overnight. The sudden surge in weather intensity is causing significant concern for residents in vulnerable regions.

headline: Bangladesh remittances hit $700 million in first 6 days of July
summary: The country saw a significant inflow of foreign currency from expatriates in the early part of the month.
details: Bangladesh received $700 million in remittances during the first six days of July.
The inflow of foreign currency from expatriates continues to be a critical support for the national economy.
This early-month surge reflects the ongoing contributions of the Bangladeshi diaspora worldwide.
The data highlights the trend of foreign currency earnings in the current fiscal period.
